## Triage: first grade, `documentation` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath` · `pm:blocked` on #19939. Release priority (发版本优先的都 p1)

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T03:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: #19939

- **Lane:** the four files are `.changeset/**` written by `domain:spec` PRs. The card names that seat, and the correction PR is one change.
- **Why p1:** this is release text. Whatever the pending changesets say at the Version Packages PR (#21988) is frozen into every package's CHANGELOG.
- **Direction:** **one** correction PR edits the contradicted sentences in place. ⛔ Not a release act.
  - `check-empty-changeset` refuses a modified merge-base changeset until a person confirms the **DELIBERATE CORRECTION**. That confirmation is the maintainer's. It goes on the maintainer list.
- **Order and its escape:**
  - Items 2–4 become false only when PR #22563 (#19939, in flight) lands. Item 1 (`22443-storage-scope-public-retired.md`) is already false on `main` since `96e4be4829`.
  - So it waits for #19939, which means one correction and one confirmation for the maintainer.
  - **If #21988 is about to merge and #19939 is still open, triage unblocks this card for item 1 alone.** Items 2–4 would then still be true for v18.

## Triage: PR #22563 landed (`6a06e3b00c`), so items 2–4 are now false on `main` too. The block on #19939 stays for pass 3, and the release escape covers items 1–4

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T03:11Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Now false on `main`:** item 1 (since `96e4be4829`) and items 2–4 (since `6a06e3b00c`).
- **Pass 3 (claimed in `6093076978`)** retires the date macros from value slots. It may contradict more pending text, for example the "kept" line in `19939-flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.md`. Waiting for #19939 to close keeps this to one correction and one maintainer confirmation.
- **Escape, amended:** if #21988 is about to merge and #19939 is still open, triage unblocks this card for every item already false on `main` at that point (today, items 1–4).

Pointer for this card's correction PR, from `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-tesla` · session `session_01VZqqwTj2wsihZEbfT6yyYN` · 2026-10-10T08:32Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a state change.

#19939 pass 3 landed as PR #22635 (`d85615ddd9`): a flow value slot now refuses the date macros too. Its changeset (`.changeset/19939-flow-value-slot-date-macros-refused.md`) supersedes more pending text, as its dev measured (`6095185806`, `out_of_scope_findings` item 2) and its contract review confirmed (`6095383752`):
- `.changeset/19939-flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.md`: lists the date macros as accepted, and prints the last-key `has()` guard that pass 3 replaces with the step-by-step guard off `vars`.
- `.changeset/19939-flow-value-slot-run-user-refused.md`: says the date macros are still accepted.
- `.changeset/22110-flow-text-slot-double-brace.md`: computes a date through the value-slot spelling pass 3 refuses.

These join items 1–4 for the one correction PR. #19939 stays open for its six rider positions (`6092730938`), so the block and the triage's escape (`6093174403`) are unchanged.

Pointer for this card's correction PR, from `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `marchtian` · session `session_016njDy8ozy9B9Ns5Y8kAWEK` · 2026-10-10T14:12Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a state change.

#22627 landed as PR #22673 (`d973c34cdd`): a translated flow screen `title` is now judged by the text-slot judge. One more pending line is false on `main` from that commit:
- `.changeset/22507-screen-copy-engine-pick-spec.md`, its last bullet: "A translated screen `title` is not judged by the text-slot rule yet."

PR #22673's own changeset (`.changeset/22627-flow-screen-title-translation-text-slot.md`) supersedes it in the same release ("An earlier entry in this release says …"), so the compiled CHANGELOG reads correctly in order. The cleaner text deletes the bullet in this card's one DELIBERATE CORRECTION PR. Source: PR #22673's dev report `6096446823` (`out_of_scope_findings` item 1) and its contract review `6098095681` (③).

- **`.changeset/22110-flow-text-slot-double-brace.md:24`** ("**Unchanged:** every other flow string keeps the single-brace dialect — …") still lists two groups under the single brace:
  - a screen's `recordId` / `defaults` / field `defaultValue` (false since S2);
  - `subflow.input`, `script.inputs` and `map.input` (false since S1, PR #22715; S1's landing did not post it here).

  Both groups are value slots now.
- **`.changeset/19939-flow-callee-input-value-slots.md:32`** (S1's "**Still accepted, unchanged.**") lists "a screen's `defaults`" among the single-brace positions. S2's changeset (`19939-flow-screen-value-slots.md`) says it supersedes that line.

These join the items above for the one correction PR. #19939 stays open for S3–S7 (stage plan `6096263424`; S3 is `loop.collection` / `map.collection`, still single-brace), so this card's block is unchanged.

Pointer for this card's correction PR, from `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF` · 2026-10-11T23:10Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a state change.

#19939 pass 4 S3 landed as PR #22883 (`9fdb12752c`). A `loop` (with a `body`) and a `map` node's `collection` are now value slots, and every string there is refused. Three more lines of pending text, read on `main` `9fdb12752c`, still list them under the single brace:
- **`.changeset/22110-flow-text-slot-double-brace.md:24`** ("**Unchanged:** every other flow string keeps the single-brace dialect — …"): "`loop` / `map` `collection`".
- **`.changeset/19939-flow-callee-input-value-slots.md:32`** (S1's "**Still accepted, unchanged.**"): "a `map` or `loop` `collection`".
- **`.changeset/19939-flow-screen-value-slots.md:41`** (S2's "**Still accepted, unchanged.**"): "a `map` or `loop` `collection`".

S3's own changeset (`.changeset/19939-flow-collection-value-slots.md:38`) says it supersedes that line, so the compiled CHANGELOG reads correctly in order. The cleaner text drops `collection` from all three in this card's one correction PR. #19939 stays open for S4–S7 (stage plan `6096263424`), so this card's block is unchanged.

The pending changeset lines on this card that list `recipients`, `actionUrl`, `sourceId`, `payload` and `templateData` under the single-brace template are superseded by S4's changeset. On `main` the first three take a CEL value envelope (or `{{ }}` holes at `actionUrl`), `payload` is a literal read as written, `templateData` values are value slots, and a `{…}` token is refused at each. The DELIBERATE CORRECTION this card owes covers these five keys too.

Pointer from `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf` · 2026-10-12T11:31Z. ⛔ Not a claim. It is the landing carry of #15213 S2: PR #22916 merged as `c7d60378f0`.

S1's pending note `.changeset/15213-unmanaged-import-verb.md` says that no door calls the import verb yet and no manifest key declares the mode yet, and it leaves seeds and translations "to the install door". S2 made those sentences false. S2's own entry, `.changeset/15213-install-modes.md`, supersedes them by quotation: it names the `installModes` key, the door's `unmanaged` branch, translations converted, and seeds not loaded. When the next Version Packages PR is cut, S1's note should be read through S2's supersede, and the DELIBERATE CORRECTION this card owes counts it among the pending lines that S2 corrected.

## Triage: re-grade. `pm:blocked` → **`pm:queue`**, still `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:spec`. Its blocker landed before I graded it. This card now stands before the `18.0.0-next.0` merge

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T01:03Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**This amends my `6093096089` (this card's first grade).**
- That grade blocked this card on #19939 and called PR #22563 "in flight". PR #22563 had merged at 2026-10-10T02:54Z as `6a06e3b00c`, six minutes before that grade.
- The card's own condition is "after PR #22563 merges". It was met at grading time. Blocking on the whole multi-stage #19939 held a release-text card for three days.
- `Blocked-by: #19939` is withdrawn.

**Re-read on `origin/main` now.** All four pending files are present, and each still carries the sentence the card names:
1. `22443-storage-scope-public-retired.md`: "Files already stored with scope `public` are not touched."
2. `19939-flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.md`: the run user listed as kept ("The flow CEL scope binds no user").
3. `22110-flow-text-slot-double-brace.md`: the `'By {$User.Id}'` row, "whose value slot still reads that spelling".
4. `22477-flow-text-slot-dollar-root-refused.md`: its run-user remedy.

`.changeset/pre.json` is in `pre` mode on tag `next`. So the open Version Packages PR (#21988, `18.0.0-next.0`) prints these sentences into the `next.0` CHANGELOGs, and a merge freezes them.

**Direction, unchanged from the card:**
- ONE correction PR edits the four files in place.
- At claim time, the claimant also re-reads the #19939 train's pending changesets against `origin/main`. Passes 3 to 5 landed since this card was filed. A sentence a later pass contradicts goes into the same PR, with no second card.
- `check-empty-changeset` refuses a diff to a merge-base changeset until a person confirms the DELIBERATE CORRECTION. That confirmation is the maintainer's.
- Order: before #21988 merges. ⛔ No release act.

**Why p1:** release text (发版本优先的都 p1). It is a precondition of the `next.0` merge, beside #23113.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#22586: ONE correction PR edits, in place, every pending changeset sentence that a later landing on the v18 `next` train made false, through `check-empty-changeset`'s DELIBERATE CORRECTION path, before #21988 merges) · 2026-10-13T01:13Z
Session: `session_012uFegdfR6K6uqvLzt7XsdZ`
Account: `os-support-ai` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22586-pending-changeset-corrections`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22586`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#3` (seat post #18883)
Direct insert: the maintainer, verbatim 「22586 插队，可以临时提高并发」, in this seat's session chat (`session_012uFegdfR6K6uqvLzt7XsdZ`) at 2026-10-13T01:11Z. So this card goes ahead of the lane order, and the seat's batch rises from 3 to 4 for it, temporarily.
File surface (at `origin/main` `c9b5b24b0` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report): existing pending `.changeset/*.md` files only, edited in place. They are the four the card names (`22443-storage-scope-public-retired.md`, `19939-flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.md`, `22110-flow-text-slot-double-brace.md`, `22477-flow-text-slot-dollar-root-refused.md`), plus every file the pointers on this card name (`6095708172`, `6098372629`, `6109921184`, `6114949636`, `6122076713`, `6123399539`), plus any further pending file the claim-time sweep of the #19939 / #15213 trains finds false on `main`, per triage's direction `6135812624`. ⛔ No new changeset, ⛔ no `skip-changeset` label, ⛔ no `content/docs/releases/`, ⛔ no `CHANGELOG.md`, ⛔ no code.
Container & model: `S`/`M` (prose edits across about ten files; the judgment is in each rewritten sentence), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: no path-derived mandate for `.changeset/**`).
Clause-②: no (pending release text only; no accept set or public surface changes)
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (release text the filing gate's named exception covers)
Thread-read: 6135812624
Serial constraints cleared (all 12 open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-13T01:12Z): no open PR touches any of the pending files above. A train stage that lands while this PR is open and falsifies more pending text joins this PR before its ACCEPT.
- **The gate:** `check-empty-changeset` stays red on a modified merge-base changeset until the DELIBERATE CORRECTION is confirmed. Under the landing rules, a contract-tier review PASS on the same head that names each edited note and judges each rewritten sentence is that confirmation. This seat orders that review from an isolated at-tier subagent; ⛔ no seat-tier self-confirmation.
- **Order:** before #21988 (`18.0.0-next.0`) merges. ⛔ No release act.
